title: S09T01 - Produce signed npm, Homebrew, shell, and PowerShell release candidates
description: Build versioned artifacts, checksums, provenance, install scripts, package metadata, and channel-correct upgrade paths from one tagged source commit.
acceptanceCriteria: Release candidates install without the source checkout through npm, Homebrew, POSIX shell, and PowerShell paths.
Artifacts expose matching versions, schemas, checksums, source commit, license, SBOM or dependency inventory, and verification instructions.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
